title: Island of the lotus eaters hotel
content: Has anyone had any similar experiences with a hotel in the middle of the desert? A few years back one night I ended up in this hotel that was in the middle of the desert. The hotel itself reminded me of one of the older grand ones in NY but the front of it was open. I don’t remember much about the inside besides it hand a grand lobby with a second floor balcony. This balcony is where I met the manager who was observing the hotel with me and asked why don’t you stay? The whole thing gave island of lotus eaters vibes. I haven’t been able to forget this place even tho I’ve only been there once.
